lines.zh: 我四条腿走得很轻，几乎无声
lines.en: I walk light on four legs, nearly silent.

lines.zh: 尾巴后面拖着一点水痕
lines.en: A faint wet trail drags behind my tail.

lines.zh: 我贴着草走，眼睛不停扫
lines.en: I walk close to the grass, eyes sweeping.

lines.zh: 我的毛是湿的，一直没干
lines.en: My fur is wet and never dries.
I circle the chicken coop once.

lines.zh: 海嗣的部分让我走得更稳
lines.en: The Seaborn part keeps my steps steady.
I hop a low wall without effort.

lines.zh: 走着走着，耳朵忽然竖起来
lines.en: Mid-stride, my ears snap up.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留下浅印
lines.en: My steps leave shallow prints.
I creep along the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我沿着堤岸走，水在下面响
lines.en: I walk the bank, water sounding below.

lines.zh: 小体型占便宜，我能钻过去
lines.en: My small frame lets me slip through.
I drop low, tail hanging.

lines.zh: 我走近鸡群时步子更慢
lines.en: I slow further as I near the chickens.

lines.zh: 草地边缘，我一直沿着走
lines.en: I keep to the edge of the grass.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼刚才的草丛
lines.en: I glance back at the grass I left.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草里，只露两只眼
lines.en: I crouch in the grass, only eyes showing.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵会先动，然后才是头
lines.en: My ears move first, then my head.
Water drips from my fur tips.

lines.zh: 我在听兔子刨土的声音
lines.en: I listen to a rabbit digging.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢摆，一下，又一下
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, once, then again.

lines.zh: 这副身子不大，但牙不软
lines.en: I am not large, but my teeth are not soft.

lines.zh: 海风把我的气味吹散了
lines.en: The sea wind scatters my scent.
I wait for the chickens to come out.
A turtle rests in the distance.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，毛还是咸的
lines.en: I lick my forepaw; the fur is still salty.
When the sounds stop, I stop.
Plenty of prey here.
I tilt my head at a window.

lines.zh: 离海太远了，我有点不自在
lines.en: Too far from the sea; I feel uneasy.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子压得很低
lines.en: I look up at you, neck held low.
You are much bigger than a rabbit.
I step back half a pace, then look.
A little of my teeth shows.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就再靠近一点
lines.en: If you stay still, I come a bit closer.
The way you walk says prey.
I am weighing whether you are worth biting.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就压低身子
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I flatten.
Is this your ground?
I sit, but I do not relax.
I yelp and spring away.
My fur puffs up.
I retreat into the grass, eyes only.
That blow knocked out a few of my hairs.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，牙全露出来
lines.en: I flatten, all my teeth showing.
Blood mats my fur; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我没有跑远，我记着你的位置
lines.en: I did not go far; I remember where you are.
I shake my head and rise.
I growl lower and meaner than before.
You struck me; I will answer it.
I know that smell.
I take two steps closer and stop.

lines.zh: 是你手里的东西吸引我
lines.en: It is what is in your hand that draws me.

lines.zh: 我低着头，一点点挪过来
lines.en: Head down, I edge over.
I do not snatch; I wait for you to lower it.
It smells better than chicken.
My tail wags first.
I open my mouth for a very small bite.
If you are slow, I nudge for more.
After eating, I keep watching your hand.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩过来，我弹开了
lines.en: Your foot comes down; I spring away.
I am too small to move you.
The bump sends me rolling.
Dirt on my fur; I shake it off.
I slip between your legs.
That collision put me on guard.

lines.zh: 我退到草丛边，回头看你
lines.en: I retreat to the grass edge and look back.
I give a low growl, very short.

lines.zh: 我们撞过之后，我记住了你
lines.en: After we collided, I remembered you.

lines.zh: 地上的草被压平了一片
lines.en: A patch of grass is flattened.
We touch noses and sniff.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴和你的绕在一起
lines.en: Our tails curl together.
We lie side by side in the grass.
You keep the east, I the west.
At any sound, we both look up.
Both our coats are wet.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边轻轻叫了一声
lines.en: I make a small sound at your ear.

lines.zh: 这片草丛够我们两个躲
lines.en: This grass is enough to hide us both.
We never stray far apart.
Hunting rabbits together is faster.
I clamp it in my teeth and shake it.
It is bigger than my head.
I bite down and drag it back.
I sniff it and decide against eating.
I hide it in the grass.
One press of my forepaw and it stops moving.
I let go and it drops.
Carrying it slows me down.
This could be traded for something.
I drag it to the water's edge.
A rabbit is moving over there.
Chicken sounds; I know them.
A turtle is slow; perfect.
I drop low and hug the ground.
It has not seen me.
Two strides is all it takes.
I pick the small one, easier to handle.
The wind blows from behind me; good.
I wait for it to lower its head.
This one I can take.
I stay still, only watching.

lines.zh: 它再走一步就进范围了
lines.en: One more step and it is in range.
My tail stops moving.
The grass blocks its sight.
I swing around to the side.
I wait for it to turn its back.

lines.zh: 我不急，饿一会儿没关系
lines.en: I am patient; a little hunger is fine.

lines.zh: 它的头抬起来了，我伏低
lines.en: Its head lifts; I flatten.
I take this step very slowly.

lines.zh: 等你走进我扑得到的圈子
lines.en: I wait until you step into my reach.
I leap and bite its neck.
My claws pin it first, then my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一下很快，几乎看不见
lines.en: So fast it is nearly unseen.
I whip my head after the bite.

lines.zh: 它挣了一下，我咬得更紧
lines.en: It struggles, and I bite harder.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，看它倒不倒
lines.en: I back half a step to see if it falls.
My teeth are short, but they serve.

lines.zh: 海嗣的那一半让我更狠
lines.en: The Seaborn half makes me crueler.
A small pool of blood remains.
I take the catch and go.

lines.zh: 草丛动了一下，我出来了
lines.en: The grass stirs, and I come out.
I climb out of the water onto the bank.
Wet fur clings to me.
This place smells of chickens.

lines.zh: 我不是自然来的，是有人放我在这
lines.en: I did not come naturally; someone put me here.
I circle the spot once first.
Wet fur clings to me; I shake it loose.
I can feel the sea far off.

lines.zh: 兔子还在那边，我已经看见了
lines.en: The rabbit is still over there; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我选了一处草最高的地方
lines.en: I choose the tallest grass.

lines.zh: 火燎到尾巴，我跳起来乱窜
lines.en: Fire catches my tail; I leap and dart.

lines.zh: 我从墙上摔下来，翻了个身
lines.en: I fall off the wall and land in a roll.
Water covers my nose; I paddle hard.
The blast throws me into the grass.
An arrow sticks in my hind leg.
A force presses me flat.
Hungry enough to eat grass seed.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我全身毛都竖了
lines.en: A flash, and every hair stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我蹬不到东西
lines.en: No ground; my legs find nothing.
